name: integracore
description: IntegraCore is a program for managing your business

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev-fe: concurrently -n frontend -c green "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n backend,frontend,electron -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w electron"
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run bundle -w backend
scripts.build:server-all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:client-all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dist:server: npm run build:server-all && cd backend && npm run bundle && cd ../electron && npm run build:server
scripts.dist:client: npm run build:client-all && cd electron && npm run build:client
